flagsdescription.title: llvmnet LLVM to .NET CIL Toolchain Flags
flagsdescription.flag: Runs the llvmnet C, C++, or Fortran compiler driver. Clang/Flang 22 emits LLVM bitcode, which is lowered to .NET CIL.

Selects a runtime and ABI contract. System uses the Linux x86-64 ABI, glibc and native pthreads through generated ABI bridges. Portable uses the toolchain-owned LP64 dotnet64-v1 ABI and managed adapters. Managed-host is the legacy managed runtime with Linux host headers. Object modes cannot be mixed.

Publishes the generated CIL executable using .NET 10 NativeAOT. The default NativeAOT optimization preference is Balanced. The generated executable embeds the .NET runtime and any generated native ABI call bridges; ordinary system-library dependencies remain.

Selects Clang/Flang O1 optimization for LLVM generation. The driver defaults to disabling loop and SLP vectorization and C stack protectors because those lowering paths are not yet complete. LLVM global dead-code elimination is applied during executable linking.
Selects the benchmark's LP64 data-model portability definitions.
